caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an ornate design, portrayed in a front-facing view. The chair is reddish-brown with decorative carved elements on the backrest, legs, and seat apron. The backrest has intricate cut-out patterns, including curved and symmetrical shapes with a central roundel and decorative motifs around it. The top rail of the backrest is gently arched with small scrolled ends. The front legs are cabriole-shaped with elaborate carvings at the knees and feet, while the back legs are straighter and simpler. The seat is upholstered in a light-colored fabric with pale, muted floral patterns in colors such as soft pink, green, and hints of blue. The background is plain, off-white or beige paper with some visible smudges and faint sketches. There is a signature “S. Roy” in the lower right corner of the drawing, and a faint watermark or sketch in the upper right corner.
title: Chair
